corpus_provenance: Author-written public issue texts fixed before feature encoding and evaluation; no profile data or held-out tuning.

baselines: fixed class-frequency majority with alphabetical tie break
evaluation_policy.lifecycle: First query has one active bank. Activate the ninth class, teach proof_integrity ten examples total and expire its first two, then query two banks. Reopen the durable instance in a fresh process and issue a fresh query for identical feature bytes.
evaluation_policy.prediction: Descending exact rational class dot-sum divided by its retained example count; alphabetical tie break. Untaught classes are absent.
evaluation_policy.scope: Fixed author-written utility observations. The first checkpoint has no example for network_transport. Membership and FIFO teaching change together; no accuracy-gain, benchmark-generalization or reader-privacy claim.
